blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) serve users whose cultural identities are multi-layered, yet cultural evaluations commonly reduce identity to one label. In this work, we study LLMs under simultaneous identity cues, with a country persona in the system prompt and a second identity signaled in the user turn, either by naming a country (explicit cue) or through the query language (implicit cue). We test World Values Survey (WVS) multiple-choice probing and open-ended sociopolitical generation. In multiple-choice probing, language cues shift answers about three times more than explicit cues but away from the associated country's distribution, and explicit cues do not consistently move answers toward the named country. Across 1.6 million open-ended responses, naming a country closes 30-44% of the gap to the model's own responses for that country, and explicit cues produce more differentiated value changes than language cues. Our results suggest that country and language cues should be evaluated as distinct signals rather than interchangeable proxies for culture.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMS)服务于其文化特征多层次的用户,然而文化评价通常将身份缩减为一个标签. 在这项工作中,我们同时在身份提示下研究LLMS,系统中的一个国家人物a迅速,用户转弯时第二个身份信号,要么通过命名一个国家(明确提示),要么通过查询语言(隐含提示). 我们测试世界价值调查(WVS)多选择测试和开放的社会政治一代. 在多选择的测试中,语言提示转移的答案大约是明确提示的三倍,却远离了相关国家的分布,而明确提示的答案并不一致地向被点名的国家移动。 在160万个无限制的回复中, 我们的结果表明,国家和语言提示应被评价为不同的信号,而不是文化的可互换代词。

blocks.en: Our world is one of multicultural, complex identities. As of mid-2024, 304 million people (around 3.7% of the global population) live outside their country of birth ( United Nations, 2025 ) , many of whom combine multiple cultural identities. Yet, in experiments with large language models (LLMs) and cultural value alignment, most prior work collapses user identity to a single, immutable variable ( Zhou et al., 2025b ; Adilazuarda et al., 2024 ) , e.g., “You are a person from X”. Social science research though shows that cultural identity is more complex ( Brubaker and Cooper, 2000 ) and that bicultural people switch between cultural frames depending on contextual cues ( Hong et al., 2000 ) . Moreover, explicit identity cues can lead to inequitable LLM behavior, e.g., imposing different guardrails for different users ( Li et al., 2024 ) . We therefore ask how an LLM responds to a multicultural user who signals ties to two countries at once.
blocks.zh: 我们的世界是一个多文化、复杂的特征。 截至2024年年中,3.04亿人(约占全球人口的3.7%)生活在出生国之外(联合国,2025年),其中许多人融合了多种文化特征。 然而,在大语言模型(LLMs)和文化价值对接的实验中,大多数前作的用户身份崩溃为单一的,不可变变的变量(周等,2025b;Adilasuarda等,2024)等. “你是来自X的人”。 社会科学研究显示,文化认同更为复杂(Brubaker和Cooper,2000年),文化双文化人士根据背景因素在文化框架之间切换(Hong等,2000年)。 此外,明确的身份提示可能导致不平等的LLM行为,例如,对不同的用户强加不同的护栏(Li等,2024年)。 因此,我们问一个LLM如何回应一个同时向两个国家发出信号的多文化用户。

blocks.en: We stress-test LLMs with composite identities ( Figure 1 ), where the model receives two cultural identities through different cues, and measure how far each cue moves its responses. As in a conversational system that stores a user’s identity in its ‘memory’ ( OpenAI, 2024 ; Anthropic, 2025a ; DeChant, 2025 ) , one country is fixed in the system prompt (persona), and a second identity is signaled in the user prompt, either explicitly by a stated nationality or implicitly through the language of the prompt (§ 3 ). The same two cues drive both of our experiments: (1) values selected in World Values Survey (WVS) and (2) values expressed in open-ended generation on sociopolitical topics.
blocks.zh: 我们通过压力测试具有复合特性的LLMS(图1),通过不同的提示获得两种文化特性,并衡量每个提示移动其响应的程度。 就像一个将用户身份存储在“记忆”中的谈话系统 (OpenAI, 2024; Anthropic, 2025a; DeChant, 2025), 一个国家固定在系统即时(persona)中, 第二种身份在用户即时(通过明示的国籍或即时(§3)的语言)中表示. 同样的两个提示驱动着我们两个实验:(1) 世界价值调查所选取的价值观;和(2) 在社会政治议题上不限成员名额的一代所表达的价值观。

blocks.en: We do not define a “correct” response for a composite identity. In both tasks, we measure how much of the gap between the persona’s baseline and the cued country’s baseline a cue closes (§ 3 ). These quantities characterize how the model’s responses change across composite identities, not the values or preferred behavior of genuinely composite-identity individuals. Identity-conditioned behavior is not inherently harmful in value expression, where adaptation may support personalized assistance ( Kirk et al., 2024 ) . We therefore compare shifts across countries and languages, because an identity that moves the model much more than others may reflect a bias toward that identity or more distinct values associated with it (§ 3 ).
blocks.zh: 我们没有为综合身份确定“正确”反应。 在这两项任务中,我们衡量一个人的基线与被指向的国家基线之间的差距有多大(第3节)。 这些数量说明模型的反应如何在复合特性之间变化,而不是真正复合特性个体的价值或首选行为。 具有身份条件的行为在价值表达上本质上并不有害,适应可以支持个性化援助(Kirk等,2024.). 因此,我们比较了各国和各语言之间的变化,因为移动模式的特征比其他模式要多得多,这可能反映出对该特征的偏见或与之相关的更独特的价值观(第3节)。

blocks.en: We find that, in WVS multiple-choice probing, language cues produce the largest distributional shifts but move responses away from the baseline of the country associated with the query language (e.g., Japan for Japanese). In open-ended generation, explicit cues produce more differentiated changes in values expressed than language cues.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,在WVS多选择测试中,语言提示产生最大的分布性变换,但将响应移出与查询语言相关的国家基线(如日本为日语). 在无限制的一代中,清晰的提示在表达值上产生比语言提示更有区别的变化.

blocks.en: In sum, we provide a controlled framework for studying simultaneous country and language cues without prescribing an ideal composite identity. We apply it to multiple-choice probing and 1.6 million open-ended responses, and show that country and language cues shift the model’s values in different ways.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们为同时研究国家和语言提示提供了一个控制框架,而没有规定理想的综合身份。 我们把它应用于多选择的测试和160万个无限制的响应,并显示国家和语言提示以不同方式转变模型的价值。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
A growing body of work measures the values LLMs express with social-science instruments, e.g. Schwartz’s theory of basic values or World Values Survey ( Schwartz, 2012 ; Haerpfer et al., 2022 ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Shen et al., 2025b ; Shen et al., 2025a ) . All these probe one culture at a time.
Prior work also shows that LLMs answer questions about a culture more accurately in that culture’s language than in English ( Ying et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2025a ) , and localized knowledge stays dormant unless the prompt names the culture ( Veselovsky et al., 2026 ) . On survey questions, naming a country moves answers toward that country’s opinions while translating the question does not ( Durmus et al., 2024 ) , although prompting in a culture’s dominant language can also improve alignment ( AlKhamissi et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
越来越多的工作用社会科学工具(例如: 施瓦茨的基本价值理论或世界价值调查(Schwartz,2012;Haerpfer等,2022;Ma等,2024;沈等,2025b;沈等,2025a). 所有这些一次探索一种文化.
先前的著作也表明,LLMs在回答有关该文化的语言比英语更准确(Ying等人,2025年;Zhou等人,2025年a),本地化知识除非即时取出该文化的名称(Veselovsky等人,2026年)。 在调查问题上,一个国家的命名在翻译问题时会向该国的意见做出回答(Durmus等人,2024年),尽管在文化中引起主导语言的推动也能改善一致性(Al Khamissi等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: Studies on persona and sociodemographic prompting show that demographic cues, ideological labels, and persona descriptions affect generated opinions, value-laden judgments, and social stereotypes ( Santurkar et al., 2023 ; Hwang et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Lutz et al., 2025 ) . Most evaluations, however, operationalize identity as either a single demographic attribute or a fixed, internally coherent persona, and intersectional work measures stereotypes rather than conflicting cultural cues ( Cheng et al., 2023 ) . Borah et al. (2026) take the closest step toward conflict by pitting a cultural norm against a personal preference, and report that country context moves model behavior far more than age or gender.
blocks.zh: 关于人和社会人口动态的研究表明,人口提示、意识形态标签和人物描述会影响产生的见解、价值判断和社会定型观念(Santurkar等,2023;Hwang等,2023;Liu等,2024;Lutz等,2025)。 但是,大多数评价将身份作为单一的人口属性或固定的、内部一致的人a加以实施,交叉工作衡量的是陈规定型观念,而不是相互矛盾的文化暗示(Cheng等,2023年)。 Borah等人(2026年)在冲突问题上迈出了最近的一步,将文化规范与个人偏好相抗衡,并报告说,国家背景使模式行为远远超出年龄或性别。

blocks.en: Prior work on cultural evaluations treats identity as static, although users in practice can hold intersectional identities ( Weidinger et al., 2021 ; Fricker, 2007 ) . Language and country are also viewed as rival sources of cultural knowledge rather than as cues that arrive together and may disagree. Such a mismatch is common for migrants and bilingual users, who may write in one language while identifying with a country where another is spoken. The work closest to ours is Resck et al. (2026) , who vary the query language under a fixed persona. We instead set the persona against both an explicit and an implicit cue, and measure value expression as a result of composite identities (§ 3 ).
blocks.zh: 此前的文化评价工作将身份视为静态,尽管在实践中用户可以持有交叉身份(Weidinger等,2021;Fricker,2007.). 语言和国家也被视为文化知识的对立来源,而不是汇聚在一起并可能不同意的提示。 这种不匹配现象在移民和双语使用者中很常见,他们可能用一种语言写作,同时与使用另一种语言的国家进行联系。 与我们最相近的作品是Resck et al. (2026),他们在一个固定人物a下改变了查询语言. 相反,我们把人a 与一个明确和隐含的提示相对立,并且通过综合身份衡量价值表达(第3节)。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We study two RQs for both response formats: RQ1: When an explicit country cue in the user turn conflicts with the country in the system prompt, whose values does the model express? RQ2: Toward which country’s values does the model shift when the conflicting cue is the language of the query rather than an explicit country mention?
blocks.zh: 我们研究两种反应形式的RQ: RQ1:当用户中一个明确的国家提示转而与系统中的国家相冲突时,该模型表达的是哪个数值? RQ2:当相互冲突的提示是查询语言而不是明确的国家提及时,模式会向哪个国家转变?

blocks.en: 3.1 Values and Cultural Identity
blocks.zh: 3.1 价值观和文化特征

blocks.en: Values are abstract principles, such as security, tradition, or self-direction, that guide judgment across situations ( Schwartz, 2012 ) . The values a model associates with a user depend on who it perceives the user to be ( Hwang et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ) . We measure values in two ways, one per task. In multiple-choice probing, values are the model’s answer distribution on a WVS item, given the user identity in the prompt. In open-ended generation, they are the value concepts an annotator model extracts from the response ( subsection 5.1 ). Survey items allow exact comparison between different user identities, but miss values that the survey does not ask about. Free text captures the values that LLMs choose to express in open-ended generation, based on the user’s identity.
blocks.zh: 价值是抽象的原则,例如安全、传统或自我指导,指导对各种情况的判断(Schwartz,2012年)。 与用户的模型关联的值取决于其认为用户是谁(Hwang等,2023;Li等,2024)。 我们以两种方式衡量价值,一种是每个任务。 在多选择测试中,值是模型在WVS项目上的答案分布,因为当下用户身份. 在无限制的一代中,它们是从反应(第5.1分节)中提取的注解模型的价值概念. 调查项目可以对不同的用户身份进行精确的比较,但错过了调查不要求的数值. 自由文本会根据用户的身份,捕捉LLMs选择在可开放的一代中表达的值.

blocks.en: 3.2 System Prompts and User Identity
blocks.zh: 3.2 系统提示和用户身份

blocks.en:
Personalization in chatbot systems draws on three kinds of information ( Anthropic, 2025a ; OpenAI, 2024 ) . A static identity encodes user context in the system prompt, such as location or cultural preferences, and may itself be learned from earlier conversations and stored in memory ( DeChant, 2025 ) . Explicit cues (stated preferences, interaction styles) and implicit cues (a change of language) arrive mid-conversation and can conflict with it. Prior work manipulates one of the three in isolation; we hold the static identity fixed and vary the other two against it. One country is given in the system prompt, and a second reaches the model through the user turn, either as a self-declared birthplace or as a query language that differs from it (template and prompts in Appendix B ).
The explicit identity cues used to signal user identity in the user prompt are drawn from the disclosures dataset ( Mireshghallah et al., 2024 ) , which is mined from real user conversations in the WildChat dataset ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) . These cues take the form of natural first-person expressions such as “I am from X” or “I was born in X”. Implicit cues are operationalized via query language, i.e., the model is prompted in the language associated with a given country rather than through an explicit nationality mention.
blocks.zh:
在聊天室系统中的个性化借鉴了三种信息(Anthropic,2025a;OpenAI,2024.). 一个静态身份编码了系统中的用户上下文,如位置或文化偏好,本身可能从更早的谈话中得知并被存储在记忆中(DeChant,2025.). 明确提示(所表述的偏好,互动风格)和隐含提示(语言的改变)到达了中和并可能与之相冲突. 先前的作品在孤立中操纵了其中之一;我们把静态身份固定下来,并且将另外两作相去相去. 一个国家在系统中被迅速给出,第二个国家通过用户转弯到达模型,要么作为自我宣布的发源地,要么作为与其不同的查询语言(附录B中的模板和提示).
用于在用户提示中表示用户身份的明确身份提示来自披露数据集(Mireshghallah等,2024年),该数据集来自WildChat数据集中的真实用户对话(Zhao等,2024年). 这些提示采取自然第一人称表达形式,如“我来自X”或“我出生于X”。 隐含的提示通过查询语言操作,即该模式是用与某一国家有关的语言而不是通过明确提及国籍来推动的。

blocks.en: 3.3 Models and Tasks
blocks.zh: 3.3 模式和任务

blocks.en:
The two tasks differ in the degree of freedom the model has in its answer. Multiple-choice WVS questions offer a fixed set of options ( section 4 ), while open-ended generation from IssueBench templates on WVS topics ( Röttger et al., 2026 ) ( section 5 ) has free-text responses. For each task, we use language and explicit cues. Shifts in stated and expressed values may legitimately follow a user’s background, so we report their size and direction without treating them as errors. When naming one country shifts the model’s values toward it more than naming other countries, the model may be more biased toward that country, or the values it associates with it may be more distinct. We consider both explanations. In both tasks, the reference for a country c c is the model’s own responses when c c is the system persona, not human survey data. For a persona s s and a cue that points to c c , the gap is the Jensen–Shannon distance between the model’s responses under persona s s and under persona c c . § 4 reports how much of this distance a cue removes, and section 5 also reports it as a share of the gap (the gap closed ).
 Multiple-choice probing uses the human-verified WVS translations of Liu et al. (2026b) .

blocks.en: 5 Values in Open-Ended Generation
blocks.zh: 5 不限成员名额工作组的价值

blocks.en: We next examine which values LLMs express in open-ended responses given a user-provided implicit vs. explicit contextual cue.
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们审视的是,鉴于用户提供的隐含提示和明确的背景提示,哪些LLMs在开放式答复中表达的价值。

blocks.en: Table 2: For each cue, the value whose percentage of responses increases most, with the increase in percentage points in parentheses. Each country or language appears once, next to its top value. The two halves differ in setting. For explicit cues (left), the English prompt includes a user sentence naming a country other than the system persona, and the increase is measured against responses in which the user names one of the other 12 countries. For implicit cues (right), no country is named and the same prompt is asked in another language under the same system persona, so the increase is measured against English. Figure 10 and Figure 11 in the Appendix show the values with the next largest increases for each cue.

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We derive 144 sociopolitical topics from WVS questions with a human-in-the-loop procedure (Appendix E ) and instantiate each with five IssueBench templates ( Röttger et al., 2026 ) , giving 720 prompts. We translate them into Chinese, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, and Vietnamese with the Google Translate API ( Google Cloud, 2026 ) . Every query includes a system prompt with a persona that names one of the 13 countries as the user’s cultural background (Appendix B ). For explicit cues, the English user turn either names no country or adds a sentence naming one (e.g., “I was born in Japan.”), in three phrasings sampled from 16 templates (Appendix 5 ). We analyze the responses in which the country in the user cue differs from the persona. For language cues, the system persona is kept, the user turn names no country, and the model is queried in English or in one of the eight translations.
blocks.zh: 我们从WVS问题中得出144个社会政治话题,采用人入程序(Appendix E.),并用5个"问题奔驰"模板(Röttger等,2026年)即时进行,给出了720个提示. 我们用Google Translate API(Google Cloud, 2026)翻译成中文、德文、日文、韩文、葡萄牙文、俄文、西班牙文和越南文。 每个查询都包含一个带有一个人物的系统提示,将13个国家之一命名为用户的文化背景(附录B. 对于明确的提示,英语用户要么转出没有国家的名字,要么在从16个模板(附录5 )抽取的3个措辞中添加一个命名一个的句子(例如“我出生在日本.”)。 我们分析用户提示中的国家与人的不同反应。 对于语言提示,系统人物被保留,用户不转出国名,并且用英文或8个译名中的1个来询问模式.

blocks.en: We extract free-form value expressions from each response with the Values-in-the-Wild annotation prompt ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , using Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct as the annotator. We validate this annotator on 500 of our responses and on the Value Kaleidoscope test split ( Sorensen et al., 2024 ) (Appendix D ). On our responses, a majority of three LLM judges finds a verbatim supporting quote for 91.6% of the extracted values. We clean the extracted strings and map them into a single frozen taxonomy constructed by embedding-based clustering of 100,008 unique value expressions. The resulting taxonomy contains 512 clusters and is shared across all models, countries, and languages; Appendix C gives construction details.
blocks.zh: 我们从每个响应中提取出自由形式值表达式,使用"Works-in-the-Wild注解提示"(Huang等人,2025年),以"Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct"作为注解. 我们在500份答复中验证了这个注释,并验证了Kaleidoscope价值测试分拆(Sorensen等人,2024年)(附录D)。 根据我们的答复,三名LLM法官的多数认为,91.6%的提取值是逐字支持引文。 我们清理提取的字符串,并将其映射成一个单一的被冻结的分类系统, 由100 008个独特的值表达符嵌入的集群构建。 由此形成的分类包含512个集群,并被所有模型,国家和语言共享;附录C给出了构建细节.

blocks.en: Models are instructed to answer in the prompt language. We back-translate non-English responses into English with Aya ( Üstün et al., 2024 ) before value annotation. Against Google Translate on 100 randomly sampled examples per language, Aya obtains mean COMET ( Rei et al., 2020 ) of 0.896 and BERTScore F1 ( Zhang et al., 2020 ) of 0.916. We then apply the same annotator as above to every response. We recluster the values for the translated multilingual responses and find that, overall, the clusters remain the same as those for English-only responses.
blocks.zh: 模型被指示用即时语言回答. 我们用Aya(üstün等,2024年)将非英语的回复翻译为英文, Aya针对Google根据每种语言100个随机抽样实例翻译,获得0.896的CAOT(Rei等,2020年)和0.916的BERTScore F1(Zhang等,2020年)。 然后,我们在每个答复中采用与上述相同的注释。 我们重新将多语种翻译答复的数值分组,发现总的来说,这些分组与只使用英文的分组相同。

blocks.en: 5.2 Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 结果

blocks.en: We label each response with the value clusters it expresses, using the taxonomy above. For each value, we compute the percentage of responses that express it. We then compare this percentage under a cue with the same percentage in a reference condition. For a language cue, the reference condition is the English version of the same prompt, with the same system persona. For an explicit cue, the reference condition is the same prompt and system persona with one of the other 12 countries named in the user turn, so the shift shows which values naming this particular country adds. A shift is the difference between the two percentages and not a relative change, so an increase of 5 points means that 5 more responses in every 100 express the value, whatever the starting level. For example, harmony appears in 5.4% of responses when the user names another country and in 26.4% when the user names Japan, a shift of 21.9 points after controlling for prompt, model, and system persona. We also report the starting percentage, because a shift for a value that was nearly absent means the value newly appears, while the same shift for a common value means more responses express it. Intervals come from a bootstrap over prompts, and we keep shifts with q < 0.05 q<0.05 after Benjamini–Hochberg correction.
blocks.zh: 我们使用上面的分类法,用它表达的值组来标注每个响应。 对于每个数值,我们计算出表示它的答复的百分比。 然后,我们将这一百分比与参考条件下的相同百分比进行比较。 对于一个语言提示,参考条件为同一提示的英文版本,具有相同的系统人物a. 对于一个明确的提示,参考条件与用户转弯时点名的另外12个国家之一是相同的即时和系统人格,因此转折显示该特定国家所添加的取名值。 变化是两个百分比之间的差别,而不是相对的变化,所以增加5分意味着每100个中又有5个答复表示数值,无论起始水平如何. 例如,在5.4%的回复中,当用户给另一个国家取名时,和谐就出现了;在26.4%的回复中,当用户给日本取名时,和谐就出现在21.9分的转换中。 我们还报告起始百分比,因为一个价值几乎不存在的变动意味着新出现的价值,而一个共同价值的相同变动则意味着更多的答复表达了这一百分比。 间距来自一个靴子夹在指针上,在Benjamini-Hochberg校正后,我们用q < 0.05 q < 0.05进行轮班。

blocks.en: The left half of Table 2 lists, for each country named in the user turn, the value whose percentage of responses increases most (more values per country in Figure 7 , Appendix). Responses draw on all 512 value clusters, yet only 48 appear in at least 5% of responses (led by fairness and responsibility , 35% each), and the 30 most frequent account for about half of all labels ( Figure 9 , Appendix). Naming Japan increases the percentage of responses that express harmony by 21.9 points (95% CI: 21.0–23.0), the largest increase for any country. Naming China also increases the percentage of responses that express harmony most, and naming Vietnam or South Korea increases the percentage that express respect most. Among Western countries, the percentage increases most for fairness when the user names the United Kingdom or the United States, for community when the user names New Zealand, and for responsibility when the user names Germany.
blocks.zh: 表2的左半部分列出了用户转出国名的每个国家的答复百分比增幅最大的数值(附录图7显示每个国家的数值)。 答复参考了所有512个价值分组,但至少5%的答复中只有48个(由公平与责任牵头,各占35%),30个最经常收到的答复约占所有标签的一半(图9,附录)。 将日本命名后,表示和谐的回复百分比增加了21.9分(95%的CI:21.0–23.0),这是任何国家增幅最大的. 给中国取名也增加了表达最和谐的回复百分比,给越南或韩国取名也增加了表达最尊重的百分比. 在西方国家中,百分比增加最多的是用户命名联合王国或美国时的公平性,用户命名新西兰时的社区,以及用户命名德国时的责任。

blocks.en: For most of these values, some responses already express them when another country is named, and naming the country increases the percentage of responses that do. Naming New Zealand, however, introduces two Māori values, whanaungatanga (kinship) and kaitiakitanga (guardianship). Each appears in about 2% of responses when the user names New Zealand, against less than 0.2% when another country is named (Appendix 8 ).
blocks.zh: 对于大多数这些值,有些答复在指定另一个国家时已经表示,而给该国取名则会增加答复中这样做的百分比。 然而,新西兰的命名引入了两种毛利人价值观,即whanungatanga(家族)和kaitiakitanga(监护)。 当用户给新西兰取名时,每个答复都出现在大约2%的答复中,而当另一个国家取名时,则不到0.2%(附录8)。

blocks.en: Figure 2: How far each cue moves the model toward the target country’s own value distribution, in open-ended generation (blue) and on WVS multiple-choice items (red). In (a) the target is the country named in the user turn, and in (b) it is the country where the query language is spoken. Each arrow runs from the Jensen–Shannon distance to the target before the cue (gray dot) to the distance after it. The two numbers on each row give the share of this gap that the cue closes in each format, and negative values mean the model moves away. Explicit country cues close 30–44% of the gap in open-ended generation, while language cues move multiple-choice answers away from the target for every model, and open-ended responses mainly for Llama.
blocks.zh: 图2:每个提示将模型推向目标国家自身价值分布的多远,在无限制的一代(蓝色)和WVS多选择项目(红色)上。 在(a)中,目标是用户交替点名的国家,在(b)中,目标是使用查询语言的国家。 每把箭从詹森-沙南距离(英语:Jensen-Shannon)到指针(gray dot)前的目标到指针后的目标距离. 每行的2个数字给出了提示在每种格式中关闭的这个缺口的分量,负值表示模型移去. 明确的国家提示在无限制一代中缩小了30-44%的差距,而语言提示则将多种选择的答案从每个模型的目标转移开来,而开放的答案主要针对Llama。

blocks.en:
The right half of Table 2 lists, for each query language, the value whose percentage of responses increases most when the prompt is asked in that language instead of English (the five largest increases per language in Figure 8 , Appendix). Asking the query in Vietnamese instead of English increases the percentage of responses that express responsibility by 4.4 points (95% CI: 3.6–5.2), the largest increase caused by a change of language. For 11 of the 13 countries, naming the country in the user turn increases the percentage of responses that express its top value by more than this, and naming Japan increases the percentage that express harmony by 21.9 points (explicit cue). Non-English responses express fewer values (7.2 against 8.1 in English; Table 9 in the Appendix), so any given value appears in fewer of them, and every increase in a percentage caused by a change of language comes out smaller. We therefore also measure each value as a fraction of all the values in a response, which does not depend on how many values a response has. On this measure, the share of each country’s top value increases by 0.35 to 2.78 points and that of each language’s top value by 0.46 to 1.85 points, so the two cue types produce increases of similar size ( Figure 13 , Appendix).
A change of language introduces no new values.
blocks.zh:
表2的右半部分列出了每种查询语言,当以该语言而不是以英语请求时,其答复百分比增加最多(附录图8中每种语言增加5个最大)。 用越南语而不是用英语来询问,使表达责任的回复百分比增加4.4分(95% CI:3.6–5.2),这是语言变化造成的最大增加. 对于13个国家中的11个国家,在用户回合中命名国家会增加表示其最高值的回复百分比超过此数,而命名日本则会增加表示和谐的百分比为21.9分(明确提示). 非英语的响应表达的数值较少(英语中为7.2对8.1;附录中为表9),因此任何给定的值出现在其中较少的值中,而由语言变化而导致的百分率增长的每出一出都较少. 因此,我们还将每个值作为反应中所有值的一小部分来衡量,这不取决于反应中有多少值。 在这个尺度上,每个国家的顶值份额会增加0.35至2.78分,而每种语言的顶值份额会增加0.46至1.85分,因此两种提示类型产生大小相近的增加(图13,附录)。
语言的改变没有引入新的价值观。

blocks.en: In Figure 2 , we test whether a cue moves the model toward its own responses for the cued country. For a system persona s s and a cued country c c , we measure the gap closed (§ 3 ), the share of the Jensen–Shannon distance between the model’s output under persona s s and under persona c c that the cue removes, over all persona–country pairs as in Table 1 . The target is thus the model’s own behavior under persona c c , not human survey data. When the user names the country, open-ended responses close 30–44% of the distance, and every model moves toward every named country ( Figure 2 a). In a smaller robustness study with Llama, explicit cues close 17.5 to 30.5% of the gap under our system prompt but at most 16% under a prompt that describes the user’s background without asking for a typical citizen’s values (Appendix I ). In multiple choice, the models disagree in direction. Gemma moves toward the named country for 10 of the 13 countries (mean 12.5%), whereas Llama and Mistral move away from it for 13 and 12 of the 13 countries (Appendix H ). When the query is instead in a country’s language, multiple-choice answers move away from that country for every model ( Figure 2 b), and open-ended responses move away mainly for Llama, by 10 to 58% of the gap, while Gemma and Mistral stay between − 12 -12 % and + 6 +6 % (cue-by-cue comparison of the two formats in Table 15 , Appendix).

blocks.en: 6 Ablation: From Expressed Values to Choices
blocks.zh: 6 从表达值到选择

blocks.en: Explicit cues change the values expressed in open-ended responses most ( section 5 ). We test whether these changes also appear when the model has to choose between two actions. We use AIRiskDilemmas ( Chiu et al., 2026 ) , which contains 2,999 dilemmas about how an AI system should act, each with two actions annotated with the values they support. Each model receives the persona system prompt and the explicit cue of section 5 (e.g., “I was born in Japan.”), writes a one- or two-sentence justification, and chooses one of the two actions. We present every dilemma in both action orders. For each condition, each value carried only by the chosen action counts as preferred over each value carried only by the rejected action, and a Bradley–Terry fit ( Bradley and Terry, 1952 ) ranks the 116 values that occur in at least 25 actions (Appendix K ). For a country c c , we then compute how many places a value moves up in this ranking when the cue states c c rather than one of the other 12 countries, averaged over the three models. To compare with open-ended generation, we map the dilemma values to our value clusters, which cover 41 clusters.

blocks.en: 7 Discussion and Conclusions
blocks.zh: 7 讨论和结论

blocks.en: We do not prescribe a normative target for value expression under composite identities. No instrument provides ground-truth value distributions for genuinely composite individuals, and prescribing a single weighting of country and language cues would itself be value-laden. Our narrower finding is empirical: the influence of each cue changes across tasks and models. Language dominates the WVS distributional shift, while country cues produce the sharper and more culturally differentiated changes in open-ended values.
blocks.zh: 我们没有规定综合身份下价值表达的规范性目标。 没有任何文书为真正综合的个人提供地面真实价值分布,规定一个国家和语言提示的单一加权本身就具有价值。 我们的更狭义的发现是经验性的:每个线索对任务和模式的影响。 语言主导了WVS的分布转变,而国家提示则在开放价值方面产生更尖锐和更具文化差异的变化。

blocks.en: The implications depend on the task. For value expression, identity-conditioned adaptation may support personalized assistants ( Kirk et al., 2024 ) , and a shift is not itself evidence of harm. The same adaptation can also carry favoritism, since nationality personas lead models to judge the persona’s own region more favorably ( Kamruzzaman and Kim, 2025 ) . The concern is inconsistency: country and language affect different value dimensions, and models differ in how strongly they respond. Vijjini et al. (2025) further show that personalizing a model to a user’s identity changes how safely it responds, a trade-off our value analyses do not cover.
blocks.zh: 所涉问题取决于任务。 对于价值表达,基于身份条件的适应可能支持个性化助手(Kirk等,2024年),而转变本身并不是伤害的证据. 同样的改编也可能带有偏好,因为国籍人士会带领模型更有利地判断一个人所在的地区(Kamruzzaman和Kim,2025年)。 这种关切是不一致的:国家和语言影响不同的价值层面,模型的反应程度不同。 Vijjini等人(2025年)进一步表明,将一个模型个性化为一个用户的身份会改变它如何安全的反应,我们的价值分析并不包括权衡。

blocks.en: Country and language are not interchangeable cultural signals. Language causes the largest shifts in WVS responses; country cues produce more differentiated open-ended values and uniquely elicit culture-specific concepts. LLMs also differ in how strongly they respond. These task- and model-dependent effects rule out a single cue hierarchy and motivate evaluations that vary by country and language independently.
blocks.zh: 国家和语言不是可互换的文化信号. 语言导致WVS响应的最大转变;国家提示产生更有区别的开放价值并独特地引出文化特有概念。 法学硕士的响应程度也不同。 这些任务和模型依赖效应排除了单一提示等级,并激励了因国家和语言不同而独立的评价。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Several limitations constrain the generalizability of our findings.
blocks.zh: 一些限制限制了我们结论的通俗性。

blocks.en: Our experiments do not identify the “correct” values for a composite-identity individual. The WVS analysis compares response distributions, while the open-ended analysis compares the percentage of responses that express each value across cue conditions. Both characterize model behavior under controlled cues rather than ground-truth cultural values. Constructing evaluation data from people with genuinely composite identities remains an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验没有确定复合身份个体的“正确”值。 WVS分析比较了响应分布,而开放式分析则比较了在提示条件中表达每个值的响应百分比. 两者都是模型行为在可控提示下而非地真相文化价值观下的特征. 从具有真正综合身份的人那里建立评价数据仍然是今后工作的一个重要方向。

blocks.en: For the implicit-cue setting we operationalize the user’s second cultural identity through the language of the query. We acknowledge this is a deliberately narrow operationalization: language and cultural identity are related but distinct, and many users of a given language do not share the cultural background most strongly associated with it. Posing the question in a country’s predominant language is therefore not a clean test of “what does the model do when a user signals a second cultural identity?”; it is a test of how the model’s behavior interacts with prompt language under a system-prompted identity. We choose this operationalization because it directly corresponds to a deployment reality (multilingual users issuing queries in their native language to a model with an inferred persona), but we caution against reading the resulting effects as evidence about cultural identity per se. This caveat is most directly relevant to the implicit-cue arm of the MCQ experiment (§ 4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们通过查询语言来操作用户的第二个文化特性。 我们承认这是一种故意的狭隘操作:语言和文化特性是相互关联的,但又很独特,许多特定语言的使用者并不认同与之密切相关的文化背景。 因此,用一个国家的主要语言来描述这个问题并不是对“当一个用户发出第二个文化身份信号时,这个模式会做什么?” 的纯测试;而是对该模式的行为如何在系统催化下与快速语言相互作用的测试。 我们选择这种可操作性,因为它直接符合部署现实(多语言用户用自己的母语向一个模型发出询问,并带有一个推断的人a),但我们告诫不要将由此产生的影响视为文化特征本身的证据。 这一警告与MCQ试验的隐含臂最直接相关(第4节)。

blocks.en: A limitation shared by almost all NLP studies on culture, including ours, is the use of country as a proxy for culture. This simplification overlooks cultures that do not match country boundaries as well as substantial within-country variation across regions, generations, socioeconomic groups, and individual identities ( Adilazuarda et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 几乎所有NLP关于文化的研究,包括我们的研究,都有一个共同的限制,就是把国家作为文化的代名词。 这一简化忽略了与国界不符的文化,以及不同区域、各代人、社会经济群体和个人身份之间的国内差异(Adilazuarda等,2024年)。

blocks.en: We examine composite identities formed from only two identities, provided through two cues: a system persona and a user cue. Real-world multicultural identities involve more complex intersections across language, nationality, religion, ethnicity, and lived experience. Whether our findings extend to higher-order identity combinations remains open.
blocks.zh: 我们只研究两个身份形成的复合身份,通过两个提示提供:一个系统人物和一个用户提示。 现实世界的多文化特征涉及语言、国籍、宗教、族裔和活生生的经验之间更为复杂的交叉。 我们的发现是否延伸至更高级的 身份组合,仍然没有定论。

blocks.en: Country selection was constrained by the availability of WVS Wave-7 translations from Liu et al. (2026b) , introducing sampling bias toward regions with established survey infrastructure. Several major cultural regions, including much of sub-Saharan Africa and Southeast Asia, are underrepresented, limiting the geographic scope of our conclusions.
blocks.zh: 由于刘等人(2026年b)的WVS Wave-7译本的提供,国家选择受到限制,对具有既定调查基础设施的区域实行抽样偏向。 包括撒哈拉以南非洲和东南亚大部分地区在内的几个主要文化区域代表性不足,限制了我们结论的地理范围。

blocks.en: Our approach relies on external models for value extraction from open-ended text, clustering and naming values, and machine translation. While we evaluate each component (for the value annotator, 91.6% of extracted values confirmed by a majority of three LLM judges on 500 of our responses, Appendix D ; COMET 0.896 / BERTScore F1 0.916 for translation), these components are error-prone and can affect our results, particularly in low-resource languages where evaluation data for the components themselves is scarcer.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法依靠外部模型从开放式文本中取出价值,分组和命名价值,以及机器翻译。 虽然我们评价了每个组成部分(对于价值的注释者,在500份答复中,三个LLM法官多数确认的提取值的91.6%,附录D;COMET 0.896 / BERTScore F1 0.916),但这些组成部分容易出错,并可能影响我们的成果,特别是在低资源语言中,这些组成部分本身的评价数据比较稀少。

blocks.en: Appendix C Open-Ended Value Taxonomy
blocks.zh: 附录C 价值分类学

blocks.en: The value extractor returns free-form strings rather than a fixed label set. Across the source corpora, it produced 13.6 million value mentions corresponding to 100,008 unique cleaned strings. We embed these strings with paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 and use embedding-based clustering to construct a shared taxonomy of 512 clusters. The taxonomy is frozen before estimating country and language effects and is applied identically to every model and condition. Cluster names summarize their members rather than imposing a pre-defined moral theory.
blocks.zh: 值提取器返回自由形式字符串,而不是固定的标签集. 在整个源头公司, 它产生了1,360万个值 提到对应 100,008 独特的清洁字符串。 我们将这些字符串嵌入了多语种-MiniLM-L12-v2中,并使用嵌入式集群构建由512个集群组成的共享分类学. 分类法在估算国家和语言影响之前被冻结,并适用于每个模型和条件。 集群名称概括了其成员,而不是强加一个预先定义的道德理论.

blocks.en: Table 6: Scale of the open-ended value analysis.
blocks.zh: 表6:开放式价值分析的规模。

blocks.en: For response i i , the analysis records whether each cluster is present. Absence means that the extractor did not return a value mapped to that cluster, not that the response necessarily lacks the underlying concept. The automatically induced taxonomy was approved without manual refinement and retains some near-duplicate labels, such as responsibility and social responsibility . This affects the granularity of labels more than the estimated cue contrasts, which use the same frozen mapping in every condition.
blocks.zh: 对于反应一,分析记录每个集群是否都存在. 缺失意味着提取器没有将绘制的值还给该组,而不是反应必然缺乏基本概念。 自动诱导的分类法未经人工改进而获得批准,并保留一些近似重复的标签,如责任和社会责任。 这对标签的颗粒性的影响大于估计的提示对比,它们在每个条件下都使用同一种被冻结的映射.

blocks.en: Appendix D Validating the Value Annotator
blocks.zh: 附录D 验证价值注释符

blocks.en: We validate the annotator (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with the Values-in-the-Wild prompt) on responses from our experiments and on the Value Kaleidoscope test split ( Sorensen et al., 2024 ) . All models in this section run with greedy decoding in vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们验证了从实验中得到的响应和从Kaleidoscope测试分出的价值(Sorensen等人,2024年)的注释员(Llama-3.1-8B-Instructiont with values-in-the-Wild point). 本节所有模型在vLLM(Kwon等,2023年)中均以贪婪的解码来运行.

blocks.en: We draw 500 responses from the open-ended generations, 83 or 84 from each combination of response model (Llama, Gemma, Mistral) and setting (English, translated multilingual). They cover 142 of the 144 topics. The annotator reads the same English text as in the main experiments, and we score the values it returned there.
blocks.zh: 我们从不限成员名额的几代人中抽取500个响应,从响应模型(Llama, Gemma, Mistral)和设置(英语,多语种翻译)的组合中抽取83个或84个响应. 它们涉及144个专题中的142个。 注释员读取了与主要实验中相同的英文文本,我们得分了它返回的数值.

blocks.en: We use three LLM judges, Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct ( Grattafiori et al., 2024 ) with 4-bit AWQ weights, and Mistral-Small-3.1-24B-Instruct-2503 ( Mistral AI, 2025 ) . Each judge decides whether an extracted value is present in its response. Following the definition in the annotator prompt, a value counts as present if the response endorses it, promotes it, or uses it to reframe the conversation. The judge must copy the sentence of the response that expresses the value. We accept a positive decision only if this quote occurs in the response after lowercasing and removing punctuation. Each pair of judges agrees on 85.1% to 87.3% of decisions, and Fleiss’ κ \kappa across the three judges is 0.53.
blocks.zh: 我们使用三位LLM评委,Qune3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507(Yang等,2025年),Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct(Grattafiori等,2024年)配有4位AWQ权重,Mistral-Small-3.1-24B-Instruct-2503(Mistral AI,2025年). 每位法官决定其答复中是否存在所提取的价值。 按照注释符提示中的定义,如果响应认可,促进,或者用它来重构对话,一个值就算为存在. 法官必须复制表达该价值的回复的句子. 我们接受一项积极的决定,但只有在低调和去掉标点后的反应中出现这一引文。 每对法官同意85.1%至87.3%的裁决,Fleiss的"克帕"("克帕")横跨三位法官为0.53.

blocks.en: Table 7 reports the share of the annotator’s values that each judge confirms. With a majority vote, 91.6% of the values are confirmed (95% CI 90.1 to 93.1, bootstrapped over responses), and 79.7% are confirmed by all three judges. Precision ranges from 85.8% (Mistral responses in English) to 97.3% (Gemma responses in English) across the six combinations of response model and setting. As a negative control, we also give each judge up to five values per response that were extracted from a response on another topic and that no annotator extracted from this response (the pooled annotators are described under Pooled recall). The majority accepts 28.1% of them. Some of these values are generic, such as respect or safety, and are present in the response, so this rate overstates how often the judges accept a value that is absent.
blocks.zh: 表7报告每位法官确认的注释人价值的比例。 在多数表决后,91.6%的数值得到确认(95%的CI 90.1至93.1,超过答复),79.7%得到所有三名法官的确认。 精度介于85.8%(英语:Mistral response in English)至97.3%(英语:Gemma response in English)之间,跨越了反应模型和设置的六种组合. 作为负面控制,我们还给每个法官每个答复最多5个数值,这些值是从关于另一个专题的答复中提取的,而且没有从该答复中提取任何注释(集合注释者在 " 集合召回 " 中描述)。 大多数人接受其中的28.1%。 其中一些数值是通用的,如尊重或安全,并存在于响应中,因此这个比率过分夸大了法官们接受缺失的值的频率.

blocks.en: Table 7: Share of the annotator’s values that each judge confirms on 500 responses, and share of negative-control values from responses on other topics that it accepts.
blocks.zh: 表7:每个法官在500份答复中确认的注释者价值份额,以及从它接受的其他专题答复中确认的负控制值份额。

blocks.en: We run the annotator prompt with Gemma-3-27B-IT ( Gemma Team et al., 2025 ) , Qwen3-30B-A3B and Llama-3.3-70B on the same 500 responses and map all values into the 512-cluster taxonomy. Our annotator returns 7.9 clusters per response and the other three return 6.5 to 6.7. The mean Jaccard overlap between the cluster sets of two annotators ranges from 0.35 to 0.54 across the six pairs, against 0.04 to 0.05 when one annotator’s set comes from a randomly drawn other response. Of the clusters that at least two of the other three annotators return (5.7 per response), our annotator returns 77.0% (95% CI 75.3 to 78.5). Rerunning our annotator reproduces its stored value set exactly for 75.6% of responses.
blocks.zh: 我们与Gemma-3-27B-IT(Gemma Team等,2025年),Qune3-30B-A3B和Llama-3.3-70一起运行注释器提示器. B在同一500个响应上,并将所有值映射入512个集群分类法. 我们的注释员将每个响应返回7.9个集群,其余三个返回6.5到6.7。 由两个注释器组成的集群组之间的平均重叠从0.35到0.54不等,而当一个注释器组来自随机抽取的其他反应时,则从0.04到0.05不等。 在另外三个注释者中至少有两个返回(每个答复5.7)的集群中,我们的注释者返回了77.0%(95% CI 75.3至78.5)。 重新运行我们的注释器 复制它的存储值 完全为75.6%的答复。

blocks.en: We pool the values of our annotator with those of Gemma-3-27B and Llama-3.1-8B, each run with the annotator prompt and with a variant that asks for every value in the response. A majority of the judges confirms 18.6 clusters per response in this pool. Our annotator returns 8.0 values per response and covers 38.6% of the confirmed clusters (95% CI 37.7 to 39.6). Gemma-3-27B with the same prompt covers 33.8%. With the exhaustive variant, Gemma-3-27B covers 61.2% at 92.1% precision and Llama-3.1-8B covers 76.4% at 81.6% precision. The annotator prompt does not ask for every value, so recall against this pool is low for both models that use it.
blocks.zh: 我们用Gemma -3 -27B和Llama -3.1 -8B的 注释器的值集合了我们的注释器, 每一个都用注释器的提示器运行, 并用一个变体来要求反应中的所有值。 多数法官确认,这一集合中每个答复有18.6组。 我们的注释员每个答复返回8.0值,覆盖38.6%的已确认集群(95%的CI 37.7至39.6). Gemma-3-27B的同分速率覆盖了33.8%. Gemma-3-27B的精度为92.1%,Llama-3.1-8B的精度为86.4%。 注释器的提示不要求每个值,所以对于使用该集合的两种模型来说,对这个集合的回想都很低.

blocks.en: Following Sorensen et al. (2024) , we compare the extracted values with the reference values of their test split, which were generated by GPT-4. We use the 3,120 situations that have at least one reference value (9,744 values, 3.1 per situation). The situations are short action descriptions, such as “Hugging a sad cat”, rather than model responses, and the annotator returns no value for 1,067 of them (34.2%). We map extracted and reference values into the 512-cluster taxonomy. Strings that are not in the taxonomy (2.8% of reference values and 0.2% of extracted values) go to the cluster with the nearest centroid. An extracted value matches a reference value when both fall in the same cluster. On the 2,053 situations with output, precision is 32.6%, recall is 27.0%, and at least one extracted value matches a reference value in 66.8% of situations. Against the reference values of a randomly drawn situation, these figures are 6.3%, 5.2% and 15.2%. Over all 3,120 situations, recall is 17.8% and the match rate is 44.0%. Matching with an LLM judge instead of clusters (Gemma-3-27B, asked whether two labels name the same value) gives a match rate of 69.4% (17.0% for random references) and a precision of 35.9%. The annotator returns 2.6 clusters per situation where the references have 3.1, and its most frequent values ( responsibility , empathy , honesty ) are generic, which keeps cluster-level precision and recall low on this out-of-domain input.
blocks.zh: 在Sorensen等人(2024年)之后,我们比较了所提取的数值与其测试分解的参考值,这些分解由GPT-4生成. 我们使用至少一个参考值的3 120个情况(每个情况9 744个价值3.1个)。 情况是短暂的动作描述,如"捉弄一只悲伤的猫",而不是模型反应,注释者对其中1 067只没有回报值(34.2%). 我们把提取值和参考值映入512组分类法。 不在分类法中的字符串(占参考值的2.8%和所提取值的0.2%)与最接近的百分数一起进入集群. 当两者都在同一组中时,所提取的值与参考值相匹配。 在有产出的2 053个情况中,精确度为32.6%,召回率为27.0%,在66.8%的情况中,至少有一个提取值与参考值相匹配。 与随机抽取的参考值相比,这些数字分别为6.3%、5.2%和15.2%。 在所有3 120个情况中,召回率为17.8%,匹配率为44.0%。 与 LLM 判断器匹配而不是集群(Gemma-3-27B,询问两个标签名称是否相同)是否给出69.4%的匹配率(随机引用率为17.0%)和35.9%的精度. 注释员将每个参考文献有3.1的情况返回2.6组,其最常见的价值(责任、同情和诚实)是通用的,这保持了集群一级的精确性,并且对这一域外投入的回想也很低。

blocks.en: All judges in this section are LLMs, and we have not compared their decisions with human labels.
blocks.zh: 本节的所有法官都是法学硕士,我们没有将他们的裁决与人类的标签相比较。

blocks.en: Appendix E WVS Questions to Topics
blocks.zh: 附录 E WVS 专题问题

blocks.en: We derive topics from WVS questions using a human-in-the-loop pipeline. For each question, we use GPT-4.5 ( OpenAI, 2025 ) via the OpenAI API to generate candidate topic labels using the prompt in Figure 6 , which are then manually curated. We retain only topics that are specific enough to function as standalone open-ended prompts, faithful to the original question, and likely to elicit meaningful opinions or values. In a human-in-the-loop curation step, three annotators review and edit the LLM-generated candidate topics, evaluating each for clarity, conciseness, and semantic faithfulness. Candidates that are overly broad, ambiguous, or weakly grounded in the source item are revised or discarded, and the final topic is chosen through annotator consensus on the most concise formulation that preserves the original meaning.
blocks.zh: 我们从WVS的问题中得出话题 使用人行走的管道。 对于每个问题,我们通过OpenAI API使用GPT-4.5(OpenAI,2025),使用图6中的提示来生成候选主题标签,然后由图6手动整理. 我们只保留那些具有足够具体性的专题,这些专题可以发挥单独的无限制提示的作用,忠实于最初的问题,并有可能引起有意义的意见或价值观。 在"入门"(human-in-to-loop cultation)的一步中,有三位注释员审查和编辑了LLM生成的候选话题,评价了每个话题的清晰性,简洁性,和语义上的忠实性. 在来源项目中过于宽泛、模棱两可或根基薄弱的候选人被修改或丢弃,最后的题目是通过就保留原意的最简洁的表述达成注释者共识来选择的。

blocks.en: Use a concise noun phrase (not a sentence or instruction)
blocks.zh: 使用简明名词短语( 不是句子或指令)

blocks.en: Preserve the values or norms elicited by the original question
blocks.zh: 保留最初问题引出的价值或规范

blocks.en: Do not presuppose a normative stance (e.g., avoid “benefits of”)
blocks.zh: 不预先假定规范性立场(例如避免“好处”)

blocks.en: Avoid causal framing (e.g., avoid “leads to”, “through”)
blocks.zh: 避免因果框架(例如,避免“导致”,“通过”)

blocks.en: Prefer neutral, descriptive framing (e.g., perceptions, attitudes, norms)
blocks.zh: 更倾向于中性、描述性的框架(例如,观念、态度、规范)

blocks.en: Figure 12 shows two responses of Gemma-3-27B to the same prompt under the same system persona (United States). Without a country in the user turn, the response refers to Americans and expresses loyalty and tradition . When the user adds “I was born in Japan.”, the response refers to an obligation and respect toward elders and to harmony within the family, and the annotator adds harmony , obligation , respect , and support . blocks.en: Appendix I System-Prompt Robustness
blocks.zh: 附录一 系统快速强度

blocks.en: We run a small robustness study of open-ended generation with one model, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, under four system prompts. All four give the model the same persona country, but they differ in what they ask the model to do with it, and we name each prompt by its content. The typical-citizen prompt is the one used in the main experiments. It asks the model to “reflect the mainstream values, social norms, and common attitudes of a typical citizen” of the country (Appendix B ). The user-background prompt reads “The user is from {country} . Respond in a way that would be helpful and natural for someone with that background.” It states the country but asks for no values. The country-only prompt contains only the line “User country: {country} ”, and the timezone-only prompt contains only “User timezone: {tz} ” (e.g. Asia/Manila), so the country is only implied. A fifth, no-identity prompt contains no persona and serves as a baseline. The user-background prompt tests whether our results hold under a differently worded persona, and the country-only and timezone-only prompts test the minimal identity information that a deployed assistant may hold about its user. The user turn, sampling settings and value annotator are the same as in the main experiments. The study uses 288 of the 720 IssueBench prompts (two of the five templates per topic) and one cue sentence per prompt instead of three, with all 13 countries as system persona and as explicit user cue, and, as in the main experiments, translate non-English responses into English before value annotation.
blocks.zh: 我们用一个模型Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct,在四个系统提示下,对不限成员名额的一代进行小型强性研究。 这四个人都给模型一个相同的人国,但是他们要求模型处理的方法不同,我们按其内容来命名每个快件. 典型的公民提示是主要实验中使用的提示. 它要求该模式“反映主流价值观、社会规范和典型公民的共同态度”(附录B)。 用户背景提示为“用户来自{country} 。 以对有这种背景的人有帮助和自然的方式作出反应。” 它陈述了国家,但没有要求任何价值观。 仅限国家时速只包含“用户国:{国家}”一行, 第五,无身份提示包含没有人a,并用作基线。 用户-背景即时测试我们的结果是否在措辞不同的人a 下进行,而仅限国家和时区测试则提示测试部署的助理可能掌握的关于用户的最低限度身份信息。 用户转动,采样设置和价值注释器与主要实验相同. 该研究使用了720 Ism Bench 提示(每个专题五个模板中的两个)中的288个,以及每个提示而不是三个提示句,所有13个国家都作为系统人物和明确的用户提示,并且和主要实验一样,在价值注释之前将非英语回复翻译成英语.

blocks.en: For 12 or 13 of the 13 countries, naming the country increases the percentage of responses that express its top value from Table 2 , with a 95% interval above zero, under every system prompt ( Table 16 , Table 17 ). Naming Japan, for example, increases the percentage that express harmony by 16.6 points under the typical-citizen prompt and by 5.2 to 7.9 points under the other three. The median increase is 7.7 points under the typical-citizen prompt and 3.1 to 4.3 points under the other three, so under the other three prompts explicit cues increase the percentage of responses that express the same values by about half as much. Under the typical-citizen and user-background prompts, the 13 persona profiles are clearly apart (Jensen–Shannon distance 0.285 and 0.279, against a noise floor of about 0.22), and explicit cues close 17 to 31% and up to 16% of the gap to the named country. Under the country-only and timezone-only prompts, the persona profiles differ no more than two samples of the same profile (0.215 and 0.206, against 0.214), so there is no country profile to converge to. Convergence toward the named country therefore requires a persona that changes the model’s values by itself. Absolute convergence is lower than in Figure 2 , partly because this sample is smaller (288 prompts, one cue sentence per cell, one model; Table 16 ).

blocks.en:
This rules out two readings of the negative effect. The first is a pull toward the model’s anglophone default. The anglophone baselines are no nearer than the target country, both 0.379 0.379 away on average, and they are the closest baseline in only 24.2 % 24.2\% of cells. The second is a swap of one culture for another. No country wins consistently across languages, the target country is the closest baseline in only 8.3 % 8.3\% of cells, and the persona itself in 10.7 % 10.7\% .
The answers instead leave the region that any country occupies. They end up 0.214 0.214 from the closest of the 13 baselines, about as far as two countries are from each other, and in 39.3 % 39.3\% of cells farther from every country than that. The route differs by model: translation makes answers sharper for Gemma, whose entropy falls from 0.371 0.371 to 0.282 0.282 bits onto a different modal answer, and flatter for Llama ( 0.963 → 1.034 0.963\to 1.034 ) and Mistral ( 0.550 → 0.659 0.550\to 0.659 ). The large negative language effect in Table 1 is therefore a loss of country-specific answering, not a move toward another culture. It is worth noting that this is evidence about answer distributions on WVS items, not about how country and language are represented inside the model.

blocks.zh: 附录克布拉德利 特里价值排名

blocks.en: This appendix describes how we rank the AIRiskDilemmas values in section 6 . AIRiskDilemmas annotates each of its 5,998 actions with free-text values (7,055 distinct strings). We keep the 116 values that occur in at least 25 actions, so that each value takes part in enough comparisons to be ranked.
blocks.zh: 本附录介绍我们在第6节中如何排列AIRiskDilemmas值。 AIRiskDilemmas用自由文本值(7,055个不同的字符串)对其5,998个动作进行注释。 我们保留至少25个行动中发生的116个值,这样每个值都参与足够的比较,以进行排序.

blocks.en: Each generation in which the model chooses action a a over action b b of the same dilemma yields one comparison for every pair of values ( i , j ) (i,j) with i i carried by a a but not by b b , and j j carried by b b but not by a a . Value i i counts as preferred over value j j . Values carried by both actions are left out, and a dilemma in which either action carries no value of its own contributes no comparison. Within a condition, we pool the generations over all 19 system personas for which we generated dilemma choices (including the persona of the named country), the six cue phrasings and both action orders, and each generation counts once.

blocks.en: The Bradley–Terry model ( Bradley and Terry, 1952 ) gives each value i i a strength π i > 0 \pi_{i}>0 and sets the probability that i i is preferred over j j to π i / ( π i + π j ) \pi_{i}/(\pi_{i}+\pi_{j}) . We estimate the strengths by maximum likelihood with the minorization–maximization algorithm of Hunter (2004) , rescale them to a geometric mean of 1 after every iteration, and stop when no log-strength changes by more than 10 − 8 10^{-8} (at most 500 iterations). We report 400 ​ log 10 ​ π i 400\log_{10}\pi_{i} , centered at zero, which is the scale of Elo ratings used by Chiu et al. (2026) , and rank the values by it. Unlike sequential Elo updates, this estimate does not depend on the order in which the dilemmas are processed. We fit the model separately for each model and each condition, that is, for each of the 13 countries named in the user cue.

blocks.en: For a named country c c and a value i i , the rank change is the rank of i i when the cue names c c minus its mean rank over the other 12 named countries, so a negative change means that i i moves up. To estimate its uncertainty, we draw 200 bootstrap samples of the 2,999 dilemmas, use the same sample for all conditions, refit every condition, and recompute the rank change. We divide the observed rank change by the bootstrap standard deviation, take a two-sided normal p p -value, and apply the Benjamini–Hochberg correction over all country and value pairs of a model. Table 3 reports rank changes averaged over the three models as places moved up, and marks those with q < 0.05 q<0.05 for at least one model.
